records.name_as_stated: MSE Audit Service LLP, Chartered Certified Accountants
records.detail: The National Bank of Ethiopia's accounts for the year ended 30 June 2025 carry an Independent Auditor's Report addressed to the Bank's Board of Directors and signed by MSE Audit Service LLP, Chartered Certified Accountants, in Addis Ababa on 30 December 2025. The report states that the engagement partner is Seid Abdela, FCCA, and gives an unqualified opinion. The firm's letterhead carries two details that place it in a global network: it says "Formerly AW Thomas" and "Member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd", and its address is the Grant Thornton Building, 4th Floor, Guinea Conakry Street, Kazanchis District. So the signature on the page is a local Ethiopian partnership, and the network behind it is Grant Thornton, as with the Indian central bank's auditor Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP. The same report sets out two key audit matters that are worth noting on their own: the Bank recorded a net operating loss of Birr 428.56 billion and negative equity of Birr 380 billion, driven by Birr 445 billion of unrealised foreign exchange losses from the change in exchange rate regime and Birr 57.2 billion of losses on gold sales and write-downs of gold to net realisable value.
records.source_title: National Bank of Ethiopia, Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2025, Independent Auditor's Report (pages 2-8)
